mapper.insert: insert into dm_device_attribute (name, device_id, device_name, control_type, type, address, status, data, plc_data, collect_date, temp1, temp2) values (#{name}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceName}, #{controlType}, #{type}, #{address}, #{status}, #{data}, #{plcData}, #{collectDate}, #{temp1}, #{temp2})

choose.otherwise: UPDATE dm_device_attribute SET plc_data = plc_data WHERE 1 = 0
